title: Functoriality between base-derived tensor cohomology models
statement: Let $R,A,B,D$ be commutative rings with $R$-algebras $A,B$ and an $(A\otimes_R B)$-algebra $D$. For complexes $Q,Q^{\prime}$ of $A$-modules, an $A$-linear chain map $f:Q\to Q^{\prime}$, and models $L,K$ of base-derived tensor cohomology [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], in every integer degree $i$ there exist a counit-compatible natural transformation $\delta:L.derived\to K.derived$ and an $(A\otimes_R B)$-linear morphism $g:H_L^i\to H_K^i$. After restriction to $B$ and conjugation by the models cohomology identifications, $g$ is the cohomology of $L.derived(f)$ followed by the component of $\delta$ at $Q^{\prime}$. Complex and restriction functors use [def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology].

source.place: Tag 06Y6, lemma-derived-base-change, functoriality and coefficient actions

proof.text: Use the two universal counits to obtain the unique isomorphism between the left derived functors (Mathlib Functor.leftDerivedUnique). Its hom is delta and its counit compatibility is Functor.leftDerived_fac.

Conjugate the induced B-linear cohomology map by the two cohomologyIso isomorphisms. Naturality of delta and f with multiplication by a, together with cohomologyIso_smul, shows that this map commutes with a tensor 1. It is B-linear, so it also commutes with 1 tensor b. Since a tensor b is their product, tensor induction proves linearity over A tensor_R B and supplies g.

theorem exists_baseDerivedTensorCohomologyModelMap
    (Q Q' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (f : Q ⟶ Q')
    (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
    (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q' D) (i : ℤ) :
    ∃ (δ : L.derived ⟶ K.derived) (g : L.cohomology i ⟶ K.cohomology i),
        Functor.whiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := ModuleCat.{u} R)) δ ≫
            K.counit = L.counit ∧
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom).map g ≫
              (K.cohomologyIso i).hom =
          (L.cohomologyIso i).hom ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (L.derived.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).map
                  ((restrict R A).map f)))) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (δ.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).obj
                  ((restrict R A).obj Q'))))
